title: Hygiene items to pack
prompt: Name two hygiene items to pack for the trek.
hint: Look at the packing essentials list: think toilet paper and sanitizer.
sample: Bring hand sanitizer and toilet paper.

ja.prompt: トレッキングに持って行く衛生用品を2つ挙げてください。
ja.hint: 持ち物リストを見てください。トイレットペーパーや消毒液を考えてください。
ja.sample: 手指消毒剤とトイレットペーパーを持って行ってください。

local.prompt: ट्रेकका लागि सरसफाइका दुई सामान भन्नुहोस्।
local.hint: प्याकिंग सूची हेर्नुहोस्: टॉयलेट पेपर र स्यानिटाइजर सम्झनुहोस्।
local.sample: हात स्यानिटाइजर र टॉयलेट पेपर लैजानुहोस्।

local_pron.prompt: Trekka lagi sarasfai ka dui saamaan bhannu hos.
local_pron.hint: Packing suchi hernus: toilet paper ra sanitizer samjhinus.
local_pron.sample: Haat sanitizer ra toilet paper laijanu hos.

zh.prompt: 說出兩樣要帶的衛生用品。
zh.hint: 查看打包必備清單：想想衛生紙和消毒液。

en.prompt: Name two hygiene items to pack for the trek.
en.hint: Check the packing essentials list for hygiene items like toilet paper and sanitizer.
en.sample: Bring hand sanitizer and toilet paper.

en_pron.prompt: Name two hygiene items to pack for the trek.
en_pron.hint: Check the packing essentials list for hygiene items like toilet paper and sanitizer.
en_pron.sample: Bring hand san-i-tiz-er and toi-let pa-per.

title: Porters' role
prompt: What do porters do during the trek?
hint: See the role of guides and porters: think about carrying gear to save energy.
sample: They carry heavy gear so you conserve energy.

ja.prompt: ポーターはトレッキング中に何をしますか？
ja.hint: ガイドとポーターの役割を見てください。重い荷物を運んで体力を温存します。
ja.sample: 重い荷物を運んであなたの体力を温存します。

local.hint: गाइड र भरिया को भूमिका हेर्नुहोस्: भारी सामान बोक्छन् र तपाईंको ऊर्जा बचाउँछन्।
local.sample: उनीहरूले भारी सामान बोक्छन् जसले तपाईंको ऊर्जा बचाउँछ।

local_pron.hint: Guide ra bhariya ko bhumika hernus: bhaari samaan bokchhan ra tapai ko urja bachauchhan.
local_pron.sample: Uniharule bhaari samaan bokchhan jasle tapai ko urja bachaucha.

zh.prompt: 搬運工在徒步期間做什麼？
zh.hint: 查看導遊和搬運工的角色：他們會幫忙搬重物，讓你節省體力。
zh.sample: 他們搬運重物，讓你節省體力。

en.prompt: What do porters do during the trek?
en.hint: Refer to the guides and porters section: porters carry heavy gear so trekkers save energy.
en.sample: They carry heavy gear so you conserve energy.

en_pron.prompt: What do porters do during the trek?
en_pron.hint: Refer to the guides and porters section: porters carry heavy gear so trekkers save energy.
